title: Static all-items route is shadowed by dynamic feed-items route
reasoning: FastAPI/Starlette evaluates routes in registration order. Because /podcasts/{feed_id}/items is registered before /podcasts/items/all, a request to GET /podcasts/items/all matches the dynamic route first with feed_id='items'. UUID validation then fails before list_all_podcast_items can run, making the claimed endpoint effectively unreachable and returning a 422-style path validation error instead of the expected list of podcast items.
reproduction: GET /media/podcasts/items/all with a valid API key; the request is handled as /podcasts/{feed_id}/items with feed_id='items' rather than by list_all_podcast_items.
recommendation: Register /podcasts/items/all before /podcasts/{feed_id}/items, or change the dynamic route shape so the static collection route cannot collide with the feed_id segment.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No linked tests were provided for this feature, and a repository search did not find tests exercising /podcasts/items/all or list_all_podcast_items.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add an API test that calls GET /media/podcasts/items/all with a valid API key and asserts a 200 response plus the expected MediaItemSummary list ordering.
minimumFixScope: Move the /podcasts/items/all route definition above /podcasts/{feed_id}/items and add one route-level regression test.
